updates.title: Owner: every Levies & Payments requirement checked end to end
items: Debit order: the owner downloads the pre-filled form, signs and uploads it; the agent activates it; the owner is told
Debit order collections now get a receipt number and a payment confirmation, like every other payment
If the bank returns a debit order unpaid, the owner is warned straight away
Managing agent can raise any additional charge (legal costs, electricity, admin fee, CSOS levy…) on one unit or all units – it shows on the owner’s statement and the owner is notified
Fines, interest and special levies are labelled on the statement; special levies use their own due date
Statement lines on the same day now stay in the order they happened

updates.title: Owner: Property value, Home inspection and Ask GridKya
items: Property Value Tracker: estimated value of each unit with a range and confidence, value over time, area trends and recent sales in the scheme
Estate benchmarking: “your unit grew 4,4% a year – the estate average is 3,4%”
Home inspection: photos and simple yes/no questions per room; flags cracks, damp, leaks and roof problems, how urgent they are, rough cost, and who must fix it (owner or body corporate)
One tap turns an inspection finding into a repair on the managing agent’s job board
Ask GridKya: instant answers about your levy, reference, the rules, pool hours, refuse days, meetings and contacts
Estate information: hours, contacts, emergency numbers and searchable conduct rules in one place
Market data is sample data and photo AI switches on once a provider is connected – both are labelled in the app

updates.title: Owner role and Levies & Payments
items: New Owner home: levies due across all your units and a “Needs your attention” list
Every unit has its own unique payment reference (e.g. ACA-P012)
Managing agent uploads the bank statement (CSV) – payments with the right reference are allocated automatically
Wrong reference? The owner uploads proof of payment and the agent allocates it by hand
Owners get a confirmation and a receipt for every allocated payment
Professional statements with every levy and charge, ready to print or save as PDF
Debit order form, pre-filled, to print, sign and upload
My units, My tenants & rent (renewals, deposits) and Income & costs for tax
Fixes: correct due and overdue dates, tenants no longer see the owner’s levy account, demo data made consistent
